key_facts: The project meeting aims to present work on the remote control design and functionality.
The remote control should only be used for television and not for other purposes.
The remote control will use infrared communication to connect with the television set.
A field programmable gate array (FPGA) is proposed for the remote control's functionalities.
The remote control will have embedded batteries and a charger for recharging.
The user interface design focuses on simplicity and ease of use with a screen-based navigation system.
The remote control will have a speech recognition feature for limited vocabulary, such as channel numbers and volume control.
The remote control should support multiple languages for teletext subtitles.
The team discussed the possibility of future internet access via the television set.
The team decided to focus on the remote control design without including lighting adaptive options.
The team agreed to anticipate future changes in the television system, such as the shift to digital.
The team will have a lunch break and reconvene later.
